description: This PHP file defines a console command class 'ProjectWatcherCommand' used in the Goteo project to monitor and trigger events related to project statuses such as publishing, campaigning, active, and funded states. It interacts with project models and dispatches events based on project lifecycle conditions. The command is designed for maintenance and notification purposes within the project management lifecycle.

classes.name: ProjectWatcherCommand
classes.description: A console command class for monitoring and dispatching events related to project statuses such as publishing, campaigning, activation, and funding states within the Goteo project framework.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help message for the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the main logic of the command, retrieving project lists based on specific filters, and dispatching events when certain conditions are met, optionally performing updates if the '--update' flag is used.
